Completed. Every `pages` route/file was migrated to App Router equivalents, and `pages/` was removed.

**What I changed**
- Replaced `_app` + `_document` with typed App Router root layout:
  - `app/layout.tsx`
  - Uses `metadata`, `next/font/google`, global CSS import, shared header/nav/footer, and `AppProvider`.
- Migrated page routes:
  - `pages/index.js` -> `app/page.tsx`
    - Replaced `getServerSideProps` with server component data fetching + `headers()` and dynamic rendering.

    - Replaced `getStaticProps` ISR with `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })`.

    - Replaced `getStaticPaths` with `generateStaticParams`.
    - Replaced `getStaticProps` with async server fetch + `revalidate = 300`.
    - Replaced fallback behavior with `dynamicParams = true` and `loading.tsx`.
    - Replaced `next/head` with `generateMetadata`.

  - `pages/404.js` -> `app/not-found.tsx`
  - `pages/_error.js` -> `app/error.tsx` (App Router error boundary pattern)

  - `pages/api/posts/index.js` -> `app/api/posts/route.ts` (`GET`, `POST`)
  - `pages/api/posts/[id].js` -> `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (`GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE`)
  - Uses `NextResponse` and typed request/body handling.
- Added types:
  - `types/blog.ts` for post/comment/API payload types.
  - Converted provider to typed client component:
    - `components/AppProvider.tsx` (removed `components/AppProvider.js`)
- Updated styling for link-based button usage:
  - `styles/globals.css` (`.button-link`, `main` rule)

**Removed**
- Entire `pages/` directory (all files deleted and directory removed).

- Ran `npm run build` successfully on Next `15.6.0-canary.52`.
- Build output shows only App Router routes (`/`, `/blog`, `/blog/[id]`, `/api/posts`, `/api/posts/[id]`, `/_not-found`).
